kind: Multi-level top-down footprint IoU registration against OpenFreeMap/OSM building parts; approximate, not survey accuracy
method: Model geometry at yaw 0 is projected top-down for all triangles above each level; OSM reference parts above the same level are rasterised in local ENU. Yaw is searched in 2° steps with centroid translation, then the best peaks are refined to 0.1°/0.25 m. Coverage of each nearby OSM polygon uses model geometry above the polygon base.
